name: site-kit
description: One deploy recipe, one scaffold, and the handful of utilities worth sharing across the Cloudflare Workers sites on this account.
//: No dependencies and no build step, on purpose. Consumers install this
straight from git (`npm i github:gfrmin/site-kit`), and a git dependency
never runs a build — so everything here has to be plain ESM that Node and
the Workers runtime can both load as-is.
@resvg/resvg-wasm is a peer of ./og only: the sites that rasterise OG
images already pin it (2.6.2), and the ones that do not should not be made
to install a wasm binary they never load.
